description: This file defines the LifecycleInterfaceConnector class and its nested NotificationHandler class, which manage lifecycle events and interactions with remote lifecycle management objects within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes method declarations for launching, closing, terminating apps, and handling lifecycle state changes.

classes.name: LifecycleInterfaceConnector
classes.description: Manages app lifecycle interactions, remote object creation, and state change notifications within the plugin framework.

classes.name: NotificationHandler
classes.description: Handles lifecycle state change notifications and forwards them to the parent connector.

methods.name: LifecycleInterfaceConnector
methods.description: Constructor initializing the connector with a service shell.

methods.name: releaseLifecycleManagerRemoteObject
methods.description: Releases the remote lifecycle manager object.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches an app with specified parameters.

methods.name: preLoadApp
methods.description: Preloads an app with given arguments.

methods.name: sendIntent
methods.description: Sends an intent to the specified app.

methods.name: OnAppLifecycleStateChanged
methods.description: Handles app lifecycle state change notifications.

methods.name: mapAppLifecycleState
methods.description: Maps internal lifecycle states to application states.

methods.name: GetAppInstanceId
methods.description: Retrieves the app instance ID for a given app.

methods.name: isAppLoaded
methods.description: Checks if an app is loaded.

methods.name: fileExists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists at the given path.
